mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.10% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.10%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of industrial production below 95.0 and real GDP level below 13400.0 billion dollars indicates severe supply-side economic constraints that reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and GDPC1 < 13400.0, or Rank IC for joint signal < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly inflation exceeding 225.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market with non-farm payrolls above 130000.0 thousand supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High residential construction activity above 570.0 thousand units (HOUST) drives housing-sector growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 570.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO below 94.0) and real GDP level (GDPC1 below 13400.0 billion dollars) indicate economic contraction that reduces corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO < 94.0 and GDPC1 < 13400.0, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
